title: Leagues Cup kicks off tomorrow, August 4, on Apple TV
title_zh: 联赛杯明日8月4日苹果电视开播

paragraphs.en: All 62 Leagues Cup matches will stream live on Apple TV, the only place fans in more than 100 countries and regions can watch every match. Building on the momentum of a landmark year for soccer in North America, Leagues Cup — the Concacaf-sanctioned competition featuring 18 clubs from Major League Soccer (MLS) and 18 clubs from Liga MX — kicks off tomorrow, August 4. Apple TV subscribers in more than 100 countries and regions can watch all 62 Leagues Cup matches. The fourth edition of the annual competition between MLS and Liga MX once again brings together top clubs from both leagues in a unique format that guarantees interleague matchups through the quarterfinals. For the first time, the tournament will also include four Phase One matches in Mexico. Qualified clubs from each league will compete for the Leagues Cup trophy and one of three berths in the 2027 Concacaf Champions Cup, awarded to the champion, runner-up, and third-place finisher. The Leagues Cup Champion will also earn a direct berth into the Concacaf Champions Cup Round of 16, putting the club on the path to FIFA’s premier international club competitions, including the FIFA Club World Cup. Defending champion Seattle Sounders open their title defense against reigning Concacaf Champions Cup winner Toluca FC on August 5 at 7 p.m. PT at Estadio Nemesio Díez, after capturing their first Leagues Cup title with a 3-0 victory over Inter Miami CF in the 2025 final. The 2026 tournament will also feature several global stars making their Leagues Cup debuts, including France’s Antoine Griezmann (Orlando City SC), Poland’s Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire), and Brazil’s Casemiro (Inter Miami CF), who enters the competition following his third FIFA World Cup campaign. To see the complete 2026 Leagues Cup schedule, visit leaguescup.com . Eighteen qualified clubs from each league will compete for the Leagues Cup trophy, including Inter Miami CF, which take on Atlético de San Luis on August 5. How to Watch on Apple TV Apple TV subscribers in more than 100 countries and regions can watch every Leagues Cup match in one place, with commentary in English, Spanish, and French where available. Subscribers can enjoy exclusive on-demand Leagues Cup content and a comprehensive and accessible lineup of complimentary programming, including Leagues Cup Countdown and Leagues Cup Wrap-Up in English, and Leagues Cup La Previa and Leagues Cup El Resumen in Spanish.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 62 场联赛杯比赛都将在 Apple TV 上直播，这是超过 100 个国家和地区的球迷观看每场比赛的唯一平台。 在北美足球里程碑式的一年所积累的势头之上，由中北美及加勒比足联（Concacaf）主办、包含美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）18 家俱乐部和墨西哥足球超级联赛（Liga MX）18 家俱乐部的联赛杯将于明天（8 月 4 日）开赛。 超过 100 个国家和地区的 Apple TV 订阅用户都可以观看全部 62 场联赛杯比赛。 这项每年在 MLS 和 Liga MX 之间举行的赛事进入第四届，再次汇集了两大联赛的顶级俱乐部，并采用独特的赛制，确保从四分之一决赛开始就有跨联赛的对决。 本届赛事将首次包含四场在墨西哥举行的一阶段比赛。 各联赛的晋级俱乐部将争夺联赛杯奖杯以及 2027 年中北美及加勒比冠军杯的三个席位之一，该席位将分别授予冠军、亚军和季军。 联赛杯冠军还将直接获得中北美及加勒比冠军杯 16 强的参赛资格，从而进入国际足联顶级国际俱乐部赛事体系，包括国际足联世俱杯。 卫冕冠军西雅图海湾人将于 8 月 5 日晚 7 点，在尼梅西奥·迪埃斯体育场对阵中北美及加勒比冠军杯卫冕冠军托卢卡，开启他们的卫冕之旅。 他们在 2025 年决赛中以 3-0 战胜迈阿密国际，赢得了队史首个联赛杯冠军。 2026 年的赛事还将迎来多位世界级球星的联赛杯首秀，包括法国的安托万·格里兹曼（奥兰多城 SC）、波兰的罗伯特·莱万多夫斯基（芝加哥火焰）以及巴西的卡塞米罗（迈阿密国际 CF），后者将在参加完第三届国际足联世界杯后加入这项赛事。 如需查看完整的 2026 年联赛杯赛程，请访问 leaguescup.com。 各联赛将有十八支晋级俱乐部争夺联赛杯奖杯，其中包括迈阿密国际，他们将于 8 月 5 日对阵圣路易斯竞技。 如何在 Apple TV 上观看：超过 100 个国家和地区的 Apple TV 订阅用户可以在一个平台上观看所有联赛杯比赛，并提供英语、西班牙语和法语的解说（视情况而定）。 订阅用户可以欣赏独家联赛杯点播内容以及丰富且易于获取的免费节目单，包括英语的《联赛杯倒计时》和《联赛杯总结》，以及西班牙语的《联赛杯赛前预热》和《联赛杯赛后回顾》。

paragraphs.en: Apple TV’s Leagues Cup broadcasts will once again feature Club América legend and former Mexico national team captain Pável Pardo alongside former Mexico national team striker Francisco “Kikín” Fonseca, both returning as analysts for the tournament. Apple TV subscribers can watch every Leagues Cup match in one place, with commentary in English, Spanish, and French where available. In addition to live sports, Apple TV offers premium, compelling drama and comedy series, feature films, groundbreaking documentaries, and kids and family entertainment, and is available to watch across all of a user’s favorite screens. After its launch on November 1, 2019, Apple TV became the first all-original streaming service to launch around the world, and has premiered more original hits and received more award recognitions faster than any other streaming service in its debut. More Ways to Enjoy Leagues Cup Fans can follow every moment of Leagues Cup with Apple Sports , the free iPhone app that makes it easy to stay up to date throughout the tournament. Get live scores, real-time stats, standings, and upcoming match schedules, plus dive into play-by-play updates, team statistics, and visual lineup formations. With a tap, fans can also jump directly to the Apple TV app to find matches live. Apple Music is getting fans geared up for the game with curated warm-up playlists from some of the stars of MLS, including a refreshed mix from Real Salt Lake’s Diego Luna. In Apple Maps, fans can explore Maps Guides to every stadium where MLS clubs play to learn more about the history, unique features, and supporter traditions of the stadiums at the epicenter of soccer culture in North America. In the Apple News app, fans can follow the dedicated Leagues Cup hub to read the latest stories, plus see scores and standings. And by signing up for the Apple News Sports newsletter , they can get personalized updates right in their inbox throughout the entire tournament. Fans can follow every moment of Leagues Cup with Apple Sports, the free iPhone app that makes it easy to stay up to date throughout the tournament.
paragraphs.zh: Apple TV 的联赛杯转播将再次邀请美洲俱乐部传奇人物、前墨西哥国家队队长帕维尔·帕尔多与前墨西哥国家队前锋弗朗西斯科·“基金”·丰塞卡共同出镜，两人将重返该赛事担任分析员。 Apple TV 订阅用户可以在一个平台观看所有联赛杯比赛，并享受英语、西班牙语和法语（视情况而定）的解说。 除了体育赛事直播，Apple TV 还提供优质精彩的剧情片和喜剧剧集、故事片、开创性纪录片以及儿童和家庭娱乐内容，并支持在用户所有喜爱的设备上观看。 自 2019 年 11 月 1 日推出以来，Apple TV 成为首个在全球范围内上线的全原创流媒体服务，并在首秀期间比其他任何流媒体服务都更快地推出了更多原创热门作品并获得了更多奖项认可。 享受联赛杯的更多方式：球迷可以通过 Apple Sports 免费 iPhone 应用关注联赛杯的每一个瞬间，轻松获取赛事全程的最新动态。 获取实时比分、即时统计数据、积分榜和即将进行的比赛赛程，同时还能深入了解逐字解说、球队统计数据和阵容阵型可视化信息。 只需轻点一下，球迷即可直接跳转至 Apple TV 应用观看正在直播的比赛。 Apple Music 通过精选的热身歌单为球迷们预热比赛，这些歌单由美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）的一些明星球员打造，其中包括皇家盐湖城队迭戈·卢纳带来的全新混音。 在 Apple 地图中，球迷可以探索每个 MLS 俱乐部主场球场的“地图指南”，了解这些北美足球文化核心地带球场的历史、独特特色以及球迷传统。 在 Apple News 应用中，球迷可以关注专门的联赛杯中心，阅读最新报道，并查看比分和积分榜。 订阅 Apple News 体育新闻简报后，球迷可以在整个赛事期间直接在收件箱中收到个性化更新。 球迷可以通过 Apple Sports 免费 iPhone 应用关注联赛杯的每一个瞬间，轻松获取赛事全程的最新动态。

The Leagues Cup Champion will also earn a direct berth into the Concacaf Champions Cup Round of 16, putting the club on the path to FIFA’s premier international club competitions, including the FIFA Club World Cup.

paragraphs.en: Defending champion Seattle Sounders open their title defense against reigning Concacaf Champions Cup winner Toluca FC on August 5 at 7 p.m. PT at Estadio Nemesio Díez, after capturing their first Leagues Cup title with a 3-0 victory over Inter Miami CF in the 2025 final. The 2026 tournament will also feature several global stars making their Leagues Cup debuts, including France’s Antoine Griezmann (Orlando City SC), Poland’s Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire), and Brazil’s Casemiro (Inter Miami CF), who enters the competition following his third FIFA World Cup campaign.
